dimensions.note: record logs structured entry, replay, and completion events without dossier contents.
Strict input and stored-state validation, identity, version, and chronology checks all precede writes.
Tests cover provenance, graph integrity, bounds, deterministic ordering, malformed and tampered state, replay, versioning, subject binding, and no-authority surface.
Canonical exact replay is write-free; changed or stale replay fails closed.
Published docs and fixture contain only generic synthetic identifiers.
All object schemas are strict; identifiers, text, and collections are bounded; references and provenance chronology are validated.
The dossier resource declares infinite lifetime and bounded retained generations.
This is an append-version persistence record, not an external CRUD lifecycle.
No external mutation or provider action exists.
The sole resource name is a deterministic SHA-256-derived dossierId identity; collisions fail closed.
Stored state is accessed only through readResource and validated before comparison.
